title: Above the Flock
description: A flock of sheep are herded on a ranch near Irwin, Idaho. The land belongs to the Siddoways, a family that has been sustainably raising sheep for six generations. The sheep graze in alpine meadows in the Teton Range in Wyoming each summer, before returning to Idaho to finish out their time there.
translated_description: 在爱达荷州欧文市附近的一个牧场上，一群羊正被牧人驱赶着。这片土地属于西多韦家族，这个家族已经以可持续方式养羊六代了。每年夏天，羊群会在怀俄明州提顿山脉的高山草甸上吃草，之后返回爱达荷州度过余下的时光。
